address: Westerdok 748, Amsterdam (Westerdokseiland): 2008 red-brick courtyard apartment block of 232 homes, stepped from 11 m to 35 m with a passage arch
notes: Westerdok 748 (BAG: built 2008; 192 dwellings, 34 other-use, five offices; 5,306 m2 footprint, 38 m): the brick courtyard block on the Westerdokseiland north of the Westerdoksdijk. The west front (w01-275, panorama 2022-04-21) is a three-storey base with a central passage arch under a brick tower of ten floors of square deep-set windows and flanking blocks stepping up to eight floors; the south front (w02-185, 2018-05-02) shows the curved tower of ten floors; the north front (w03-5, 2018-05-02) the balconied stair of the base.

Modelled: wall groups split by the height steps of the 3DBAG walls (surface lists, because panels 89, 112 and 102 each hold two or three heights): the west front as a 3-storey base (surface 112), a 6-storey part (surfaces 96, 193, 235, 448) and the 10-storey tower wing (surface 449); the south front tower (panel 4, 10 storeys); the north front tower wing (surface 109, 10 storeys) and the 6-storey part (110). Red-brown brick, deep-reveal square windows, the closed 3DBAG roofs.

Simplified: the passage arch under the west tower is a plain ground storey (the 3DBAG walls close it as a wall), the balcony recesses and the glazed corner loggias are plain windows, the ground shop glazing is the same window row. Not modelled: the court walls, the east side stepped stair wings (no clear panorama) and the north-west annex.

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[1] glass #3f413d not used (not darker than the wall #514a43 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[2] glass #393b3d not used (not darker than the wall #4e4e49 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[4] glass #444044 not used (not darker than the wall #47403c by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[5] glass #424648 not used (not darker than the wall #4c3a37 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept.
